meta.title: NASA findings for MARS Pathfinder – snapshot of NASA Mars Trek vector layers
meta.coordinates: Mars 2000 sphere, planetocentric latitude, east longitude −180…180; rounded to 1e-4°

missions.source: Mars Trek waypoint layers (viking, viking2, sojourner, spirit, opportunity, phoenix, curiosity, InSight, mars2020)

ez.source: Mars Trek EZMars layer 0 – Exploration Zones proposed at NASA's First Landing Site/Exploration Zone Workshop for Human Missions to the Surface of Mars, LPI Houston, Oct 27–30 2015 (NASA Evolvable Mars Campaign); zones are 100 km radius circles

aqueous.source: Mars Trek Aquieous_Mineral_Distribution_Options_clon0 – B. L. Ehlmann, C. S. Edwards (2014), Mineralogy of the Martian Surface, Annu. Rev. Earth Planet. Sci. 42:291–315 (CRISM, OMEGA, THEMIS); exact duplicates removed

hydrous.source: Mars Trek Hydrous_Mineral_Detections_OMEGA_CRISM_clon0 – J. Carter et al. (2013), Hydrous minerals on Mars as seen by CRISM and OMEGA: updated global view, JGR Planets 118, 831–858

chloride.source: Mars Trek Chloride_Salt_bearing_Material_THEMIS_clon0 – M. M. Osterloo et al. (2010), Geologic context of proposed chloride-bearing materials on Mars, JGR 115, E10012; polygon centroids

surface.source: Mars Trek RSLs_Gullies_New_IcyCraters_clon0 – active surface features; reference per entry
